subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Freezing Your Credit
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Freezing Your Credit.

hook.text: A credit freeze costs nothing, takes five minutes, and blocks most forms of identity theft.

buildup.text: When your credit is frozen, no one — including you — can open new accounts without unfreezing it.

discovery.text: You must freeze at all three bureaus: Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion.

twist.text: Despite being free and effective, less than 15% of Americans have frozen their credit.

climax.text: A credit freeze is the single most powerful tool consumers have against identity theft.

punchline.text: Free, fast, and incredibly effective. Almost nobody does it.

quiz.question: How many credit bureaus must you freeze to fully protect yourself?
